attachments.origin_landmark: lower half of the nuchal ligament and spinous processes C7-T3
attachments.insertion_landmark: mastoid process and the lateral third of the superior nuchal line

actions: extends the head and neck bilaterally
rotates and laterally flexes the head to the same side

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Wraps the deeper neck muscles like a bandage -- splenion, a bandage. Unlike sternocleidomastoid it rotates the head to the SAME side, so the two are tested against each other.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_from: origin (nuchal ligament and spinous processes C7-T3)
motor_endplate_zones.reference_line_to: insertion (mastoid process and superior nuchal line)
motor_endplate_zones.source: Delnooz CCS, Veugen LC, Pasman JW, Lapatki BG, van Dijk JP, van de Warrenburg BPC. 'The clinical utility of botulinum toxin injections targeted at the motor endplate zone in cervical dystonia.' Eur J Neurol 21(12):1486 (2014), doi:10.1111/ene.12517 -- high-density surface EMG in 18 cervical dystonia patients

injection_target_points.label: centre of the region of highest muscle spindle abundance
injection_target_points.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology, localised by spiral CT with barium sulphate labelling
injection_target_points.notes: Depth is given as a percentage of the line from the projection point on the back of the neck through the target to the front, so unlike the deep cervical targets it scales with the patient. The atlas already carries a separate endplate zone for this muscle at half muscle length from high-density surface EMG (Delnooz et al. 2014); that zone and this point come from different methods and different reference lines and are kept side by side rather than reconciled.
injection_target_points.source: He X, Wen S, Liu X, Li Y, Yang S, 'Optimal target localization for botulinum toxin A in treating splenius muscles dystonia based on the distribution of intramuscular nerves and spindles', Anat Sci Int 101(1):44-53 (2025), doi:10.1007/s12565-025-00831-8 -- 24 adults, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology and CT localisation

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
